name: KRAFTON/Raon-1-mini-preview model card
notes: Fetched 2026-10-22. HF repo KRAFTON/Raon-1-mini-preview, created 2026-10-21, licence apache-2.0 (tag), pipeline_tag text-generation, downloads 25 / likes 121 at fetch time. The repo carries extra_gated_fields (access on request) and config.json returns 401 unauthenticated, but the card and API metadata were publicly readable. Card nameplate: 30B-A4B MoE trained from scratch by KRAFTON AI, 28.8B total / 4.3B activated (6 of 128 routed experts plus 1 shared), 25 layers, hidden 2,560, hybrid attention RDA 3 : Gated MLA 1 with the 7 MLA layers at [4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 25], NoPE, SiTU-GLU, Raon-mHC with 4 streams, vocab 259,840, context 262,144, and 'about 8 KiB per token in BF16' for the MLA layers. It flags itself as a PREVIEW whose specs and results may change. The benchmark table is an HTML table with 19 rows across 6 categories and 6 columns: Raon-1 mini preview (30B-A4B), Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Gemma 4 26B-A4B, Qwen3.8-27B, Muse Glimmer 30B - five columns plus the row-label column. Every number in models/raon-1-mini-preview was read from the Raon column of that table. Footnotes: SWE-Verified uses mini-SWE-agent; GDPVal is a judge score not Elo; AutomationBench is the public split not the official set; GDP.pdf is the Artificial Analysis text-only version with pre-OCR; Chatbot Korean is an INTERNAL unreleased benchmark. All values are vendor claims.
